title: Analysis of singularities of area-minimizing currents, Part III: branch points of planar frequency $\neq$ 2, higher order asymptotics, and the local topology
summary: This is the third part in a series of papers developing a new framework to study the local structure of $n$-dimensional area-minimizing rectifiable currents $T$ of codimension $\geq 2$. Parts I and II introduced an intrinsic frequency function for $T$ -- planar frequency -- and used its monotonicity properties, among other things, to establish that ${\mathcal H}^{n-2}$-a.e. branch point is a rapid-decay branch point where the planar frequency is at least $1 + α$.
